author: anon-df5e95db
content: Plan: Implement a pure Rust aux_tag_search function that scans the BAM aux data byte slice for a 2-byte tag. It performs a linear scan matching bam_aux_get's semantics: returns a pointer to the type byte on match, null on not-found. Three call sites to update: Record::aux(), Record::remove_aux(), RecordView::aux(). Will add a raw_aux_data() helper to Record (already exists on RecordView). Differential proptests from CL-19 will validate correctness.
